Case_24005/figure1.jpg.source_caption: Figure 1a: CT Chest contrast showing multifocal ground glass and consolidative opacities.

description.short_caption: CT chest showing multifocal ground-glass opacities and consolidations.
description.detailed_description: This axial CT image of the chest, with contrast, demonstrates extensive bilateral lung involvement. There are multifocal areas of ground-glass opacities and consolidative changes, predominantly in the lower lobes. The findings suggest a diffuse inflammatory or infectious process. The heart and mediastinal structures appear centrally positioned.

Case_24005/figure2.jpg.source_caption: Figure 1b: CT Chest contrast showing multifocal ground glass and consolidative opacities.

description.short_caption: CT chest showing multifocal ground-glass and consolidative opacities.
description.detailed_description: This coronal CT image of the chest, obtained with contrast, demonstrates bilateral multifocal ground-glass opacities and areas of consolidation. The findings are distributed throughout both lungs, with no clear predilection for a specific lobe. The opacities are patchy and irregular, consistent with a diffuse pulmonary process. The contrast enhances the vascular structures, aiding in delineating the abnormalities.
